widgets_values:
retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>：母豹，adult female snow leopard, one and a half metres nose to tail with a long low body on heavy shoulders, head carried low in a slow deliberate walk; dense pale ochre coat broken by black rosettes, broad padded paws, long tail carried level, small rounded ears laid flat back.
<Picture 2>：幼豹，adolescent male snow leopard cub already taller at the shoulder and heavier through the barrel than its mother, thick soft limbs and a rounded cub head on a still-short body, sprawling or rolling without pause; woolly grey-ochre fur with blurred rosettes, oversized paws, tail tip always twitching.
<Picture 3>：天山草坡，a dry alpine meadow on a slope of the eastern Tianshan in late afternoon. Light event: a gap in the drifting cloud opens one narrow shaft that brightens a single patch of grass and leaves everything else in flat grey ink. Core landmark: one wind-bent old tamarisk standing alone on the crest, its trunk split into a low Y and its crown raked flat toward the west. Ground: thin yellowed grass over gravel, loose stones, a dry hoof-worn trail. Around: scattered grey boulders and low thorn. Fixed: none. Distance: the far slope lifts into a pale snow ridge blurred by mist. Scale anchor: a small grey hare sitting upright beside the tamarisk.

detailed_description:
Ink-wash Chinese painting language rendered as stylized 3D animation: every silhouette is closed by a bold brush outline whose edge feathers and bleeds away, and a sheet of cold-pressed xuan paper fiber grain reads over all surfaces, with broad unpainted negative space reserved for mist and empty sky; ink graded in five tones from wet dense black to pale dry grey, silk and brocade read as dry-brush hatching with one faint warm sheen, leather and metal flattened to matte silhouettes carrying only a thin dry-brush highlight along the lit edge; near-monochrome palette anchored on cold indigo-grey and lamp-black with a single restrained accent of warm ochre covering about one fifth of the frame, all light soft and diffused from one single glow event such as moonlight through a cloud gap or one oil flame, contrast held near four to one; composition follows ink-painting negative space with one blurred element crossing a foreground corner, the subject off-centre in the middle ground and the upper or outer third left empty of detail, horizon or eye line kept on the lower third, 4K clarity with visible paper texture and no saturated color.

[Shot 1] A low wide shot frames <Picture 3> in late afternoon, <Picture 2> rolling belly-up in the thin grass with the stone-strewn trail and the wind-bent tamarisk behind it, one narrow shaft of sun burning a pale patch across the gravel while the rest of the slope stays washed in flat grey ink, <Picture 2> turning its face toward the low sun and batting a beetle across the dust with an oversized paw

[Shot 2] At 00:03.000 Medium shot, <Picture 1> lying a few paces uphill with her head down on her paws and only the tip of her tail moving, watching without interest; <Picture 2> rolls into her flank, shoulder against her coat, and pushes at her chin with its muzzle

[Shot 3] At 00:06.000 Close on <Picture 2>, the beetle shell cracked under one paw, its ears flicking back as it looks up for approval, and <Picture 1> rising, shaking the dust out of her rosetted coat and stepping past it; <Picture 2>'s head turns to follow her. Sound off-screen says: <d>[Chinese]野兽总会经历一段尴尬的时期，它已经足够强壮，能够独自生存。</d>

[Shot 4] At 00:10.000 Wide again, <Picture 2> left alone in the middle of the sunlit patch with its paws loose in the grass, <Picture 1> already a small pale shape walking down the far slope, the tamarisk shadow stretching toward the empty crest as the light goes out of the grass

overall_soundscape:
Ambient sound kept very light, thin wind combing the dry stalks as the bed, the tick of pebbles rolling downhill, a beetle shell cracking under a paw, and a heavy tail brushing through grass; volume always below the narration.
